)

0x50
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
ValBase
Base to be raised to an exponent. Valid range:ValBase > 0.0
Parameters (in)
ValExp
Exponent by which to raise the base.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
float32
ValBase raised to ValExp power.
Description
Returns the ValBase raised to ValExp power, determined according to the following equation.
Available via
Mfl.h
⌋
[SWS_Mfl_00131] ⌈
V alResult = V alBaseV alExp
⌋
[SWS_Mfl_00132] ⌈
If ValExp = 0, and ValBase = 0, ValResult = 1, ( 00 = 1)
If ValBase = 0 and ValExp <> 0, ValResult = 0, ( 0ValExp = 0)
⌋
[SWS_Mfl_00133] ⌈
If ValBase and ValExp are having maximum value of type float32, the return value will
be toward positive infinity.
